test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 11 Jan 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster and the fourth letter-cluster is related to the third letter-cluster.

EXPLAIN : AEILNPX :: MEDICAL : AEICDLM :: PRIVACY : ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Logic: **First Vowels are placed in order then Consonants is placed in Alphabetical order.**

For, EXPLAIN : AEILNPX

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7d0de1b08219d3147a1a091035d5e1a74c2a76a05bb1fbf4efc549d0c35ce7aa.png] 

For, MEDICAL : AEICDLM

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/477b9c51e700de09f25cf36c005f475c485950571fa7c692520ce614e28ac132.png] 

Similarly, for PRIVACY :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/378d0be9d500b476d5bc5c1f4621e7ddfc8051e7bbad47faae08fb1bd2e7a65e.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
